ship.template:
Implement this task end-to-end: $ARGUMENTS

Read the codebase first, prefer the smallest correct change, verify results, and summarize what changed.

ultrawork.template:
Ultrawork: $ARGUMENTS

Activate all discipline agents. Do not stop until 100% complete.

plan.template:
Plan this implementation: $ARGUMENTS

Interview first. Validate scope. Return: objective, non-goals, touched files, invariants, ordered steps, risks, validation checklist.

code.template:
Implement this coding task: $ARGUMENTS

Explore thoroughly, then implement. Prefer small, testable changes. Do not broaden scope or redesign unless necessary.

ops.template:
Handle repo operations: $ARGUMENTS

Focus on tests, evals, git operations, commits, pushes, and PR creation. Do not make code edits unless explicitly told to switch back to a coding agent.

rca.description: Deep root cause analysis via Oracle
rca.template:
Investigate this problem deeply: $ARGUMENTS

Return: most likely root cause, strongest evidence, minimal fix, validation plan, residual risks.

review.template:
Review this completed work: $ARGUMENTS

Return: key findings or risks, whether the approach is sound, the single most important improvement, confidence level.

judge.template:
Review this work as a strong second opinion: $ARGUMENTS

Return: key findings or risks, whether the approach is sound, the most important fix or improvement, residual uncertainty.

jira.template:
Handle Jira tasks using MCP tools: $ARGUMENTS

Use jira_* MCP tools directly. Summarize findings and any constraints.

caveman.description: Toggle caveman mode with intensity levels
caveman.template:
Switch caveman mode to level: $ARGUMENTS

Valid levels: lite, full, ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Confirm the switch and respond in the new level from this point forward.

caveman-commit.description: Generate conventional commit messages in caveman style
caveman-commit.template:
Generate a conventional commit message for: $ARGUMENTS

Rules: ≤50 char subject, type(scope): subject format. Types: feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, chore, perf, ci, build, revert. Why over what. Body if needed. Caveman terse.

caveman-review.description: One-line PR review comments in caveman style
caveman-review.template:
Review this with one-line caveman comments: $ARGUMENTS

Format: L<line>: <emoji> <severity>: <issue>. <fix>.
🔴 bug/warning, 🟡 nit/suggestion, 🟢 praise. File:line reference. Terse. Technical substance exact.

caveman-stats.description: Show estimated token savings from caveman mode
caveman-stats.template:
Estimate token savings for this session using caveman compression.

Return: approximate tokens used so far, estimated tokens without caveman (4x multiplier), estimated tokens saved, estimated USD saved (at $3/M input, $15/M output), one-line tweetable stat.
